title: Inconsistent implementations for calculating aspect ratios

labels.name: D-Trivial
labels.description: Nice and easy! A great choice to get started with Bevy

labels.name: A-Rendering
labels.description: Drawing game state to the screen

labels.name: M-Migration-Guide
labels.description: A breaking change to Bevy's public API that needs to be noted in a migration guide

body:
## Bevy version
- 0.11.3
- the main branch as of `b22db47`

## What went wrong
Aspect ratios should be calculated as `width / height`, not `height / width`.

In the code base of the version 0.11.3 and the main branch (`b22db47`), I found that `bevy_render/src/texture/image.rs` wrongly uses `height / width` while other files correctly use `width / height`.

### v0.11.3
https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/0d23d71c19c784ceb1acfbb134dda9ce0c2adc61/crates/bevy_render/src/texture/image.rs#L260-L263

### The main branch as of `b22db47`
https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/b22db47e1003db2d712baec46c0f0a1f88b0a837/crates/bevy_render/src/texture/image.rs#L542-L546

## Additional information
Other files use `width / height`.

https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/0d23d71c19c784ceb1acfbb134dda9ce0c2adc61/crates/bevy_ui/src/ui_node.rs#L388-L391

https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/0d23d71c19c784ceb1acfbb134dda9ce0c2adc61/crates/bevy_render/src/camera/projection.rs#L121-L127

https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/0d23d71c19c784ceb1acfbb134dda9ce0c2adc61/crates/bevy_pbr/src/light.rs#L714

https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/0d23d71c19c784ceb1acfbb134dda9ce0c2adc61/crates/bevy_core_pipeline/src/bloom/settings.rs#L214

## Idea
Calculations related to aspect ratio can be confusing. So, what about the idea of creating a newtype struct like `pub struct AspectRatio(f32)`?
